where: live client while travelling to 训练室/试炼之塔
evidence: live/tower_dialog_2332.png actually shows the LOGIN page + 航行公告 + 我已知晓, i.e. the client dropped to login
recovery: gameops re-ran tools/login.py --timeout 200 (foreground), client back to world
lesson: a file named tower_dialog_*.png can silently contain the login screen; OCR every evidence frame before claiming anything

text: 为保证良好的游戏体验，本服不允许使用第三方软件、脚本或变速工具。如有发现，将根据情况处理。感谢大家的理解与配合。
action: recorded as an explicit external risk in the report; the user has authorized automation with risk accepted; no anti-cheat evasion / memory tampering / protocol forgery is used (normal capture + GUI input only)

detail: travel PASS to 辅导员训练室; enter tower PASS ('tower panel reports 第23层 reached'); round 9 -> BLOCKED: 'guardian click landed but no battle started (not in the tower interior?)' after 76s
diagnosis: the 塔 panel reports 第23层 but the executor is not actually inside the tower interior; clicking the guardian from the dialog does nothing. Same class of failure as last night's 01:11 record. NOT killed by HP (122/122) and NOT a frontmost problem (frontmost verified).
action: stopped the loop; handed the client to a manual-but-evidenced experiment to find the real interior-entry click path and to test floor selection (选择楼层 1/11/21)

detail: /tmp/seerauto.stop was created then removed after only 20s while the loop was inside a 40s+ reset path; it missed the stop. SIGINT during restart_client() did not take effect either; SIGTERM finally stopped it.
impact: the loop relaunched the game client itself, window moved (268,44)->(270,74), and the client dropped to the login flow again
lesson: stop flag must stay set until the process is confirmed gone; SIGINT is not honoured inside the client-restart path (that path needs a stop check before relaunch) -> real defect to fix

detail: farm_tower_repeat: enter_tower PASS ('panel reports 第23层') but 'guardian click landed but no battle started (not in the tower interior?)'. 2 rounds BLOCKED in 2 min. Loop then tried to travel out, failed ('star map did not open' inside tower scene), and chose client restart.
impact: tower automation unusable as shipped; needs the real interior-entry click path

detail: User states: our 4 clicks on the battery 确认 consumed the day's 8x-exp + 4x-learning time. The dialog keeps saying 本日还未开启 even after the time is spent (misleading text).
impact: irreversible loss to the user's account; buff unavailable for the rest of the night
lesson: never activate an irreversible once-per-day buff as part of UI probing; stop at read-only boundary
confirming_evidence: XP readings: 6360@23:12 -> 5830@23:30 (~530 XP during the window when the buff was live) vs 52 XP for the 23:31 battle after it was spent

evidence: tower_grind.log: 'signature miss: mean_rgb=(61,107,150)' repeated verbatim in four separate runs (including after a 3s capture warm-up was added); simultaneously LiveSession.frame_bgr() (foreground) measured RGB(153,182,171) and ctl.py shot produced a correct tower frame
diagnosis: the grinder's own background capture session delivers a constant dark frame while a foreground capture of the same window is correct; not the tower signature calibration (which matches at (159,185,173)), not the window picker (exactly one SeerGame window id=3927), not TCC (earlier nohup runs worked)
impact: ~4 h of automation attempts did not produce a single verified tower cycle; the night's XP production fell back to the agent-driven manual loop
decision: stop burning live time on the vision backend tonight; record LIVE_BLOCKED, hand the client to the manual operator until 04:00, and fix the capture path in daylight with a replay harness
note: the upstream code (sklearn-free, pure python) is unit-tested: 36 tower tests green; this is a runtime capture issue, not a logic issue
